description: Saved tests that play your web game in real windows, multiplayer included, and check its rules, flows and screens after every change.
longDescription: Keeps game tests as JSON files in tests/game/. Each opens the game in fresh windows, one per player, clicks and presses as players do, takes a player off line or reloads their page, and checks what each player sees and the game's state. The agent writes them, rules first, and runs them with the game_test tool after it changes the game; the Automated tests panel runs them for you, shows the step and frame where one failed, and runs the project's own unit tests beside them.
example.1: Write game tests for this game's rules, then run them.
example.2: Run the game tests and fix what fails.
